environment: Python 3.10 or later (requires-python >=3.10; CI tests 3.10 and 3.13), managed with uv (uv.lock, no package build). Run the tests with: uv run --frozen pytest (tests/unit and tests/integration). Cut each work item's branch from origin/main. Work items that can be built independently may each be built in parallel in a worktree of their own. Before a change to how the hook builds turns or sends traces is merged, its ticket test runs live: a headless Claude Code session (claude -p --plugin-dir <the branch's worktree>) in a scratch git folder whose own .claude/settings.local.json holds the Langfuse keys, read back through the Langfuse API. The result is posted on the work item, and the test traces are deleted afterwards.
design: A comment on the work item's GitHub issue.
